title: inserts a paragraph between a title and a following table on load
reason: Removed with the table behavior change: tables now retain authored adjacency. The new table-heading spec covers load without auto-insertion and checks that deletion persists through later edits and reopen.

title: loads adjacent headings and a table without adding gaps
reason: A heading-table-heading document loads unchanged, directly guarding against HeadingSpacing adding the removed automatic table gaps.

title: preserves paragraphs the author has not deleted
reason: The fixture has authored empty paragraphs on both sides of the table and expects both to remain, distinguishing deliberate spacing from auto-inserted spacing.

title: deletes the empty paragraph %s a table without changing its content (before and after rows)
reason: The parameter rows send Delete in the gap before the table and Backspace in the gap after it; the resulting JSON must retain the table and adjacent headings with no paragraph gap.

title: does not restore a deleted gap %s a table after typing (before and after rows)
reason: After deleting either gap, an edit triggers another transaction; the unchanged heading-table-heading block sequence catches any plugin that silently re-inserts the gap on edits.

title: undo restores the deleted gap %s a table (before and after rows)
reason: The fixture suppresses initial setContent history, then verifies undo after each directional deletion restores the corresponding paragraph location.

title: keeps deleted gaps absent when the document is serialized and reopened
reason: It serializes a table after the author deleted its preceding gap, reopens that JSON through the editor extensions, and verifies load-time normalization does not recreate the gap.
